Disclosure  to  Promote  the  Right  To  Information 

Whereas  the  Parliament  of  India  has  set  out  to  provide  a  practical  regime  of  right  to 
information  for  citizens  to  secure  access  to  information  under  the  control  of  public  authorities, 
in  order  to  promote  transparency  and  accountability  in  the  working  of  every  public  authority, 
and  whereas  the  attached  publication  of  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards  is  of  particular  interest 
to  the  public,  particularly  disadvantaged  communities  and  those  engaged  in  the  pursuit  of 
education  and  knowledge,  the  attached  public  safety  standard  is  made  available  to  promote  the 
timely  dissemination  of  this  information  in  an  accurate  manner  to  the  public. 


Mazdoor  Kisan  Shakti  Sangathan 
"The  Right  to  Information,  The  Right  to  Live"

4.  Qenerai  Requirements 

4.1  Bevel  Lead  Angle  —  45°  to  be  concentric  with  the  diameter  of  reamer  within  003  mm. 

4.2  Beck  Teper—  Back  taper  on  the  cutting  diameter  is  recommended;  when  provided  the  amount 
of  back  taper  shall  be  within  the  limits  of  tolerance  on  the  diameter. 

4.3  Flutes  —  Unless  otherwise  specified,  straight  flutes  for  right  hand  cutting. 

4.4  The  tolerance  for  parallel  shank  diameter  shall  be  h9. 

4.5  For  requirements  not  covered  in  this  standard,  it  shall  conform  to  the  requirements  as  given  in 
IS  :  5443-1969  'Technical  supply  conditions  for  reamers/ 

5.  Sampling  —  The  sampling  and  criteria  of  acceptance  shall  be  in  accordance  with  IS  :  7778-1976 
'Methods  for  sampling  small  tools/ 

0.  Designation  —  A  machine  chucking  reamer  with  parallel  shank  having  diameter*/- 12-0  mm,  made- 
from  high  speed  steel,  conforming  to  this  standard  and  suitable  for  a  hole  with  tolerance  H8,  shall 
tie  designated  ae: 

Chucking  Reamer  120  IS :  6448 

0.1  When  the  reamer  is  required  for  a  hole  with  tolerance  other  than  H8,  an  appropriate  hole  tolerance 
shell  be  included  in  the  dssignation  after  size. 

7.  Certification  Marking  —  Detaila  available  with  the  Bureau  of  Indian  Standards.

♦Values  are  given  for  guidance  only  and  applicable  for  the  diameter  d.    But  neck  diameter  d%  shall

EXPLANATORY     NOTE 

This  standard  was  first  published  in  1969.  This  standard  is  being  revised  to  bring  it  in  line 
with  the  work  done  at  ISO  level.  In  the  preparation  of  this  standard  considerable  assistance  has 
been  drawn  from  ISO  521-1975  '  Machine  chucking  reamers  with  parallel  shanks  or  morse  taper 
shank'  issued  by  the  International  Organization  for  Standardization. 


Reprography  Unit,  BIS,  New  Delhi ,  ladle 


♦-*    I  .*

'4.2  Back  Taper
